author: Kamil Mete Yalcinkaya
description: Detects rundll32 or regsvr32 executing content from a remote location or from a user-writable path. Both are Microsoft-signed and allowed by most application control policies, which is exactly why they are used to run attacker code.
false_positives: Some enterprise software registers COM objects from ProgramData during install. Scope by parent process where that occurs.
name: Signed Binary Proxy Execution via rundll32 or regsvr32
query: ((process.name : "rundll32.exe" or process.name : "regsvr32.exe") and ((process.command_line : "*http://*" or process.command_line : "*https://*" or process.command_line : "*\\\\\\\\*" or process.command_line : "*scrobj.dll*" or process.command_line : "*{'javascript': None}*" or process.command_line : "*{'vbscript': None}*") or (process.command_line : "*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*" or process.command_line : "*\\Users\\Public\\*" or process.command_line : "*\\Downloads\\*")))
